mapper.select: SELECT ddpvul.id, t.dates, t.pkg, t.version, t.user_source, t.user_num FROM (select dulr.dates, dulr.pkg, dulr.version, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknow') user_source, count(DISTINCT dulr.user_id) user_num from dwd_user_login_record dulr left join dim_user_source dus on (dus.user_id = dulr.user_id) where dulr.dates = #{dates} group by dulr.dates, dulr.pkg, dulr.version, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknow')) t left join dws_daily_pkg_ver_usrc_login ddpvul on (t.dates = ddpvul.dates and t.pkg = ddpvul.pkg and t.version = ddpvul.version and t.user_source = ddpvul.user_source)
